data.name: Spirit Bonus
data.description: When you channel a marshal, you gain a +%1 bonus on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks, as well as on spirit surge rolls. This allows the bonus to apply twice to the total result if you use a spirit surge on a Charisma check or on a Charisma-based skill check.|SpiritBonus
